"'''Polly'''" was the nickname given to [[Polydroxol]] captured by the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]]. "Polly" was studied by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Trem DeSelvaine]], who discovered both its [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] and mimetic capabilities. Polly killed DeSelvaine in an effort to escape captivity.<ref name="SS" />
